SELECT d.id, d.name, d.title, d.department, d.hospital, d.phone, d.password, d.avatar, d.create_time, d.is_deleted, d.level FROM doctor d INNER JOIN doctor_role dr ON d.id = dr.doctor_id AND dr.is_active = 1 AND dr.role_code = 'DOCTOR' WHERE d.is_deleted = 0
AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND d.department = #{department}
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.title, d.department, d.hospital, d.phone, d.password, d.avatar, d.create_time, d.is_deleted, d.level FROM doctor d INNER JOIN doctor_role dr ON d.id = dr.doctor_id AND dr.is_active = 1 AND dr.role_code = 'ADMIN' WHERE d.is_deleted = 0
AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY d.level ASC, d.create_time DESC
